adjudication.rationale: In packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts, the Zod schema uses computed keys `[z.string().toString()]` and `[z.string().optional().toString()]`. These are evaluated at runtime to plain strings (very likely the same, e.g. "[object Object]"), meaning they do not express “any key whose value is a number”. The second computed key also overwrites the first in the object literal, so the intended requirement to enforce an expiry-like numeric field is not actually validated. As a result, the “minimum” schema effectively only guarantees `access_token` (and maybe one bogus key), letting responses without any expiry field pass when sync is enabled.
